description: The account's bots of all three kinds (trader, signal, market), each with its record. Bots made in the app and through the API are listed together. A live bot (mode live) is counted from its real orders on the venue. Archived bots are left out unless archived is true, which lists only them.

archived.description: true lists only archived bots; left out, the rest.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.

venue.description: Venues to include. Omit for all.

name: list_bots

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next page. Null on the last page.

title: List bots
